subtopics.title: Redox as Electron Transfer — Agents and Their Names

questions.question: OIL RIG stands for:
options: Oxygen is light, reduction is grave
Oxidation is loss of electrons, reduction is gain of electrons
Oxidation involves liquids, reduction involves gases
Oxidation is last, reduction is going first

questions.question: In Cu + 2Ag⁺ → Cu²⁺ + 2Ag, the copper is:
options: Oxidised, because it loses two electrons as its oxidation number rises from 0 to +2
Unchanged, because it remains a metal somewhere

questions.question: The reducing agent in a redox reaction is the species that:
options: Donates electrons to its partner and is itself oxidised

questions.question: In the combustion 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO, magnesium's oxidation number changes from:
Every half-reaction in the table of standard reduction potentials is written as:
options: A reduction — ion plus electrons giving the element

questions.question: Before adding two half-reactions, you must first:
options: Multiply them so both involve the same number of electrons
Add water to balance the hydrogens

questions.question: Combining Mg → Mg²⁺ + 2e⁻ with Fe³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Fe gives the balanced equation:
A correctly balanced final redox equation must:
options: Show the electrons on the reactant side
Include the potential values from the table
Contain equal numbers of ions on both sides
Show no loose electrons, with atoms and total charge balanced on both sides

subtopics.title: Electron Bookkeeping — Every Atom Gets an Account

questions.question: The rule that lets you solve for an unknown oxidation number is:
options: The balances in a neutral compound must sum to zero
Every atom equals its group number
The heaviest atom takes the charge
Oxygen is always negative two without exception

questions.question: Sulphur runs from −2 in H₂S to +6 in the sulphate ion. This eight-unit swing tells you that:
options: Reactions between these species move a substantial number of electrons — redox
Sulphur cannot be oxidised further than +2

questions.question: An account balance that goes DOWN during a reaction means the atom:
Hydrogen's oxidation number is −1 only when it is:
options: Bonded to a metal in a hydride

subtopics.title: Coins Change Pockets — and the Trade Must Balance

questions.question: In the coin picture, reduction is:
Oxidation and reduction always occur together because:
options: Every electron paid by one species is collected by another

questions.question: "The pickpocket is named by the victim's loss" means the oxidising agent:
options: Is the species that loses electrons
Causes the other species to be oxidised, and is itself reduced

questions.question: Magnesium pays electrons in twos and iron(III) ions collect in threes, so a clean trade needs:
options: Three magnesiums and two irons — six electrons each way
